svg.text: ABADI ROVER - PI 5 + ESP32-S3 WIRING MAP
Source of truth: plan.md (locked pin table). Dashed boxes = wire later (Phase 2).
one screw bus bar / lever connector
Every "GND" on this map goes here.
USB-C: the ONLY power for the Pi 5
Brain. Gamepad on Bluetooth. No GPIO loads.
USB-C = power from hub USB-A = ESP32 COM
Never feed the Pi header 5V pins
dual USB-C · use the COM port
CS goes to ONE screen each.
DC, RST, SDA, SCL go to
ESP32 GND pin + Pi header GND → STAR (one wire each)
Power wires 20-22 AWG, signal wires 24-26 AWG. Lift the tracks for every first motor test. Set every converter before connecting its load.
Wire TB6612 power (VM, VCC, GND) and motors first. Leave PWMA / AIN / BIN / STBY empty until Stage 3. STBY sits low by itself, so motors stay off.
Confirm Rail C is a steady 3.3V before connecting relay IN1/IN2. ESP32 pins die if those IN pins sit at 4V+.
Pi 5 wants a strong 5V supply. If it reboots or shows a lightning bolt, the hub is not passing enough power.
